pipeline.evidence: noise_prior channel sigma ratio 1.8 (YCrCb); isolated noise_gaussian_YCrCb:2 gave verify_signals noise:sigma + noise:clean_residual MATCH; peeled rgb_ratio=1.477>1.4. Post-saturation amplification calibration: target sigma 14.7; nY1+satY4 sim sigma 12.2 vs nY2+satY3 26.1

YCrCb saturation leaves luma mean near-intact while boosting chroma (target chroma 2.996); HSV variants collapse luma (sat1 mean -31.2 vs target -16.8). Severity 4 chosen as balanced optimum: alone mean -15.7/var 1.676/chroma 2.396/clip 0.517; combined with nY1: mean -15.3/var 1.629/chroma 3.156/clip 0.535 vs target -16.8/1.579/2.996/0.486

Cross-family noise alternative: clip/chroma/variance near-exact, but mean -12.8 vs -16.8 and sigma 18.2 vs 14.7

analysis.rationale: Pair0 primary analysis, SIGNAL mode because sigma=14.7>=2 (PSNR unreliable). Compression ruled out (block_boundary 1.0034, unique_G 256, dct_zero 0.026); blur ruled out (spectral_slope_ratio 0.993, FFT anisotropy 0.00, PCA 0.0, no residual Wi filter support). Global must explain mean -16.8 + RGB variance 1.579 + chroma ratio 2.996 + clipped fraction 0.486 + strong grain. HSV saturation cannot (luma collapse + variance too low); brightness/contrast/gamma singles each fail a robust signal (bri1 mean -20/var 0.888; con1 mean -2.4/var 1.508; gam2 mean -28.9/var 1.143). YCrCb-space saturation strengthens chroma around neutral without luma collapse; severity sweep 2-5 shows sev4 best balances mean (-15.7) and variance (1.676). Noise identified as gaussian_YCrCb from channel sigma ratio 1.8 (+ verify MATCH of noise signals); severity 1 chosen because saturation applied after noise amplifies the wavelet estimate (sev2 combined -> 26.1). Final merged candidate (noise=priority0 -> saturation=priority2, physical order) yields pair0 signals mean -15.3, var 1.629, chroma 3.156, clip 0.535, sigma 12.2 vs target -16.8, 1.579, 2.996, 0.486, 14.7 (all within ~10-17%; verify_signals WEAK 1/4). Cross-pair check of the final pipeline on pairs 1-4: noise:clean_residual matched in all four; pair4 PARTIAL (mean matched), pairs 1-3 WEAK due to content-dependent global metrics on highly chromatic scenes. Noise seed mismatch forbids LIKELY; overall UNCERTAIN awaiting training-PSNR arbitration.
